A.name: new story preserves unfinished draft and opening another does not replace it
A.detail: New and editing another story both archive current work; archived text can be resumed.

A.name: legacy fixture intact and unknown prompt strings retained
A.detail: Dragon draft, both full stories, Unicode, paragraphs, and out-of-deck prompts preserved, including after subsequent saving.

A.name: removal persists and can be restored after reload
A.detail: Removed saved story stayed in storage and was fully restored after reload; draft unchanged.

A.name: timer optional and expiry preserves editing
A.detail: Advancing mocked clock beyond selected duration stops timer only; text input still saves.

A.name: DOM flow with 390px innerWidth, labels and focused reader title
A.detail: DOM event and explicit focus assertions only. CSS media layout, Tab order, browser keyboard activation, overflow, and visual focus not tested.

A.name: prompt reversal mechanism
A.detail: Single action restores the prior trio exactly while keeping the writing.
